screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows two dielectric media meeting at a horizontal interface, with electric field E and displacement D vectors in each medium.
screenSummary.controlArea: Controls set relative permittivity for each medium, E₁ magnitude, and toggles for components, field lines, protractor, and angles. Reset All restores the starting state.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Drag the tip of E₁ to change its angle from the surface normal, then adjust εᵣ and watch which components stay continuous.

intro.currentDetails: Electric boundary conditions at a planar interface.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows two magnetic media meeting at a horizontal interface, with H and B vectors in each medium.
screenSummary.controlArea: Controls set relative permeability for each medium, H₁ magnitude, and toggles for components, field lines, protractor, and angles. Reset All restores the starting state.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Drag the tip of H₁ to change its angle from the surface normal, then adjust μᵣ and watch which components stay continuous.

magnetics.currentDetails: Magnetic boundary conditions at a planar interface.
